title: SlopLobster: Local Browser-Based AI Coding Assistant
summary: A lightweight, open-source tool that enables autonomous AI-driven programming directly in the browser without requiring external API keys. It leverages local model execution to provide a simplified environment for agentic coding tasks and rapid experimentation.
research_notes: Maintained by PasiKoodaa alongside other local-first tools like Chat-with-Screen and Screen-Analysis-Overlay.

evolution.summary: Originally released as a satirical commentary on 'AI slop', the project evolved into a functional template for local-first browser-based agents. It is frequently cited in discussions regarding 'Vibe Coding' and the proliferation of low-effort autonomous AI systems.
